T016 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (YEucl n)),
  (∀ (m : ℕ) (x y : YEucl m) (t u : ℝ), dist (YJoin x t) (YJoin y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (z : YEucl (m + 1)), YJoin (YBase z) (YLast z) = z) ∧
        (∀ (m : ℕ) (x : YEucl m) (t : ℝ), YBase (YJoin x t) = x ∧ YLast (YJoin x t) = t) ∧
          (∀ (m : ℕ), LipschitzWith 1 YBase ∧ LipschitzWith 1 YLast) ∧ Isometry YLine ∧ Function.Surjective YLine →
    ∀ (s δ : ℝ),
      0 < s →
        0 < δ →
          ∀ (V : ℕ → Set (YEucl (n + 1))),
            YCover δ (YF E) V →
              ∀ (ε : ℝ),
                0 < ε →
                  ∃ J,
                    (∀ (i : ℕ), IsOpen (J i)) ∧
                      (∀ (i : ℕ), YLast '' V i ⊆ J i) ∧
                        (∀ (i : ℕ),
                            MeasureTheory.volume (J i) ≤
                              Metric.ediam (V i) +
                                ENNReal.ofReal (ε * 2 ^ (-↑i - 1) / (1 + (Metric.ediam (V i)).toReal ^ s))) ∧
                          ∀ t ∈ YI, YContent s δ E ≤ ∑' (i : ℕ), Metric.ediam (V i) ^ s * (J i).indicator (fun x => 1) t
'Translation.T016' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
